Multivariate Techniques · CIA 3

NSE portfolio risk decomposition

Ten stocks. Equal weights. Daily data from 2023 to 2025.

Partha S G
CHRIST (Deemed to be University)

How many patterns explain the variation?

The scree plot describes variation across the ten stocks.

■ Individual component   ● Cumulative percentage

Which patterns drive this portfolio?

Each bar is a component’s share of equal-weight portfolio variance.

Which stocks move with each pattern?

PCA loadings are correlations from −1 to +1. Blue is positive; orange is negative. Component signs are arbitrary.

Components are fitted separately for each period, so PC2 and PC3 need not represent the same pattern across periods.

What happened on the worst days?

Historical 95% Value at Risk uses observed one-day losses. It is a percentile, not a maximum possible loss.

Comparison and stress candidate

The quarters were fixed in advance. These are descriptive comparisons; no causal or significance claim is made.

Assumption checks and supporting course methods
Source: Yahoo Finance adjusted prices, downloaded through yfinance. This dashboard reads a fixed saved dataset; it does not fetch live quotes.
Portfolio variance uses daily log returns. Historical losses use simple returns and equal value weights reset each day. No transaction costs. Academic analysis, not investment advice.
